messages:
kyle: apiserver 5xx spike in us-west2 at ~10:15 UTC. controller-manager keeps restarting (OOM/backoff). Looks correlated with a big onboarding job hitting the GPU attach path. anyone seeing leader churn in etcd?

anika: seeing etcd leader changes 4x in 7m, followers showing apply latency ~200–400ms. controller-manager logs: "failed to sync node store: context deadline exceeded" repeatedly.

devon: conntrack table at 94% on most NATs. netstack shows ephemeral port exhaustion pattern. NAT logs: "no available ports for source nat". attaching 3k+ GPU pods/minute from onboarding service.

opsbot: [ALERT] apiserver_5xx_rate > 15% for 5m (us-west2). Incident channel: #incidents.

sam: quick mitigation options: 1) pause the onboarding job (low friction), 2) throttle attach concurrency in the job (preferred), 3) increase NAT ephemeral port space / add NAT instances (hotfix), 4) temporarily redirect new attaches to eu-central for smoothing.

marta: cost note — spinning extra NATs and cross-region attaches will spike egress. Long-term we should consider a small pool of reserved dedicated GPUs in us-west2 for onboarding traffic to avoid attach churn (committed cost vs huge transient API load).

kyle: I'm pausing the onboarding CI pipeline now. devon can you add a temporary iptables tweak / sysctl on the NAT host to extend local port range? (instructions below)

devon: applying sysctl net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range = 10240 61000 on 2 NAT hosts now. also spinning up 2 extra NAT instances (small) to add capacity. patching onboarding job to add exponential backoff and max concurrency=50.

kyle: sample commands I ran: ```
# extend port range
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="10240 61000"
# conntrack low-water check
conntrack -S | grep 'entries' || true
# pause the CI job
kubectl -n infra scale job onboarding-burst --replicas=0
```

anika: after NAT bump and job pause, etcd leader swaps reduced. apiserver 5xx dropped to ~2% in last 3m. controller-manager restarted once then stabilized.

marta: let's track cost delta for added NATs and cross-region attach over the next 24h. I'll open a ticket to model dedicated reserved vs burst cost for onboarding flows.

devon: opening runbook PR: add steps for ephemeral port exhaustion, recommended throttles for GPU attach, and a checklist for temporarily routing onboarding.

kyle: nice. assigning followups: devon — runbook PR, marta — cost model, sam — long-term dedicated pool proposal. thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: ack :thumbsup:

opsbot: [RESOLVED] apiserver_5xx_rate back within threshold (3m).
